conflicts.permit: Auxbrain retains data indefinitely unless you request it to be deleted (see section on your data rights).
conflicts.prohibit: We do not guarantee we will maintain indefinite records as we may purge our backups and analytics from time to time without notice.
conflicts.situation: Retaining user data when the user has not requested deletion.
conflicts.reason: The policy states Auxbrain retains data indefinitely unless deletion is requested, but immediately contradicts this by stating it does not guarantee indefinite records and may purge data without notice.
